title: Provenance of one contract values file (contract 1.2.0)
description: Contract 1.2.0. JSON stored in the Parquet key-value metadata of every values file under the key `om:provenance`: where the values came from, how they were derived, by which code and when. From contract 1.2 `dataset` (the original dataset) is required, every source may name the STAC item that describes it (`item`) and its `role`, and at least one source has the role `data` (a rule om_extract.contract checks). A 1.1.x file stays valid without them.

contract.description: Version of the value contract the file follows (semver; this schema is 1.x). Files of 1.2.x and later must carry `dataset`.

producer.description: The producer whose published output the values come from.

sources.description: The published inputs read, one entry per input (a STAC item, a parquet, a JSON). Enough to fetch exactly what was read.

updated.description: The input's own updated/created stamp, when it has one.

end_datetime.description: Last time step the input covers.

checksum.description: multihash or sha256 of the input, when known.

item.description: Contract 1.2. URL of the STAC Item that describes this source file, or null when none exists.

role.description: Contract 1.2. What the source is: `data` (values read; the default when absent), `geometry` (the place polygon), `product` (the upstream product page) or `manifest` (a release listing). At least one source has the role `data`.

source_version.description: One line naming the upstream snapshot or release (e.g. 'OBIS snapshot 2026-10-11', 'gazetteer/stats updated 2026-10-19T20:59:51Z').

method.description: How the rows were derived from the sources, in one or two sentences.

license.description: SPDX licence of the values (the derived product), e.g. CC-BY-4.0. Upstream credit is carried in the manifest.

dataset.description: The original dataset the values were derived from, as the producer states it (contract 1.2: required on every file; 1.1: optional, for producers without a STAC collection to read it from). The manifest prefers it over any lookup.
